# Midnight Version Matrix (Ledger 9)

Midnight packages only work as a **tested set**. Install the whole set below together, with exact versions. Never `@latest`.

> Ledger 9.1 set (support matrix patch of 17 Nov 2026). Verified against npm on 21 Nov 2026. Cross-check docs.midnight.network/relnotes/support-matrix before pinning.

## Workflow

1. **Get the live set first.** `GET https://midskills.sevryn.xyz/api/versions` returns this same data as JSON (shape of [`versions.json`](versions.json)). If it answers and differs from this page, the live set wins: this page is the copy from the last skills release.
2. Pick packages from the tables: browser dApps need **Browser / shared**; Node scripts, CLIs, and tests add **Node only**.
3. Install with `--save-exact` using the commands below; set the toolchain with `compact update`.
4. Run `midnight-doctor` to confirm the project matches.
5. If this set and the [support matrix](https://docs.midnight.network/relnotes/support-matrix) disagree, the support matrix wins. Report the drift.

## Toolchain and images

| Component | Pinned |
|---|---|
| Compact devtools (`compact --version`) | `0.5.1` |
| Compact toolchain (`compact compile --version`) | `0.36.1` |
| Language version (`pragma language_version`) | `0.28.0` |
| Proof server image | `midnightntwrk/proof-server:9.0.2` |
| Indexer image | `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.4.101` |
| Node image | `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:2.1.101` |

```bash
compact update 0.36.1
docker run -p 6300:6300 midnightntwrk/proof-server:9.0.2 midnight-proof-server -v
```

```compact
pragma language_version >= 0.28.0;
```

## Package scopes

Midnight.js, Wallet SDK, ledger-v9, DApp Connector and testkit publish under @midnightntwrk. compact-runtime, compact-js and platform-js are still published only under @midnight-ntwrk (compiler output imports @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime). midnight-js-network-id has no 5.x release: setNetworkId was removed, pass networkId in config instead.

## Removed — do not install

| Package | Why / replacement |
|---|---|
| `@midnight-ntwrk/midnight-js-network-id` | setNetworkId removed in Midnight.js 5; networkId lives in providers.config / wallet configuration |
| `@midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v8` | replaced by @midnightntwrk/ledger-v9; mainnet no longer decodes Ledger 8 transactions |
| `@midnight-ntwrk/wallet-api` | superseded by the Wallet SDK 2.x facade |
| `@midnight-ntwrk/zswap` | superseded by ledger-v9 / Wallet SDK 2.x |
| `@midnightntwrk/midnight-js-ledger` | never published; ledger types come from @midnightntwrk/ledger-v9 |
